verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is explicitly self-hosted: docs describe running 'one Gateway process on your own machine' with install via installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, from source, or optional Docker, and the project is open-source on GitHub. Community posts (HN) confirm users actually running it locally themselves, corroborating the self-host claim beyond marketing docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of the full self-host setup experience beyond docs and anecdotal HN posts.
